scope: 40 actual smoke inputs only; no targetGT/task scores/full-run outputs or new model/GPU calls. Descriptive, source-model queries are correlated.

residual_competition_overlap_proxy.definitions: Highest-semantic rival to selected group. Audit-only overlap flag: tightROI IoU>=.5 and anchor AABB IoU>=.25. Not point-support Jaccard or GT identity. Counter scalar omits proxy-overlap rivals only from margin calculation while keeping selected group; no actual G/box/update rerun and no proposed threshold adoption.
residual_competition_overlap_proxy.identifiability_limit: Cross-group point support sets are not saved in trace. Box/ROI overlap is only a proxy; cannot prove residual groups are duplicate physical objects or that changing dedup improves task accuracy.

matches_retained: Original last decoder prediction_heads.5 with separate 288->3 finalConv heads; center=cluster/query seed xyz+residual, direct size/no yaw.
Frozen no-grad source features are each finalConv penultimate activations, not normalized64D retrieval projection; real source Conv replay passed.
BBF uses source L2-normalized64D last query and point-conditioned cross-encoder token embeddings, temperature.07, softmax over all actual tokens including specials/sentinel.
Grounder receives fullcaption+sentinel and firstlexiconnoun span from exact model-token offsets, B1 actual token length.
XYZ sample16384 float32; deterministic per-row RNG explicitly differs original loader global/worker order; Drone float32 z+1.8, Quadidentity; no extra global centering/scaling or RGB channels added.
All backbone local normalization as pinned official architecture; no normalized lastheadfeature or re-normalized XYZ invented.
CLIP input is literal fullcaption without sentinel and pinned RGB preprocessing/L2 feature cosine, frozen evalFP32, no hidden learned logit scale.
deliberate_differences_not_missing_trick: Original GTclass-assisted synonym readout is intentionally excluded; puretext q0 is not literal original class-assisted evaluation.
Original BBS semantic classifier head is loaded but not used as this round ranking control; an alternative frozen BBS readout has not been ruled out by R8.
Only final two center/size linearConv weights/bias adapt; source training uses original BN/text dropout behavior but test adaptation keeps evalBN/dropoutoff.
Physical proposal grouping and CLIP-guided association/consensus are new G assumptions; original paper provides no guarantee of their correctness.

root_visual_boundary: Root visually observed physical support and residual same-visible-object split groups/neighbor ROI contamination; noGT access, not identity correctness labels.
